newsitem.title: USA: Tower Automotive closes A.O. Smith unit buy.
newsitem.headline: Tower Automotive closes A.O. Smith unit buy.

text.p: Tower Automotive Inc said Friday it completed its previously announced acquisition of the Automotive Products Company division of A.O. Smith Corp.

The unit supplies lower vehicle structural assemblies to major automakers and posts annual revenues of about $860 million, Tower Automotive said. The unit operates 11 manufacturing plants in North America, Tower Automotive said.
Tower Automotive supplies stamped and welded assemblies for vehicle body structures and suspension systems to major U.S. and foreign automakers.
Its shares were off 1/4 Friday at 33-3/4.
